policy: Public official/reference sources only (Wikidata, KEGG DRUG, MHLW NHI price list, RxNorm, BDPM, EMA, Taiwan TFDA, Hong Kong Drug Office, Health Canada DPD, SFDA). Validation prescriptions (Pusan, Jeonbuk, Seoul) and any other prescription data are never used. Aliases are NFKC-normalised lowercase.

wikidata.selection: all items with ATC code (P267); labels+aliases in en, ko, ja, zh, zh-hans, zh-hant, zh-cn, zh-tw, zh-hk, zh-sg, zh-mo, zh-my, fr, ar, mul

kegg.selection: all KEGG DRUG entries: generic names (EN/JA), 商品名 incl. 後発品, US products, ATC; DG03200 antipsychotic group

mhlw.selection: 薬価基準収載品目リスト (内用薬, 注射薬, 外用薬): 品名 mapped through 成分名 (KEGG/Wikidata Japanese names)
mhlw.note: MHLW (厚生労働省) official list; added in addition to the listed sources

bdpm.selection: all CIS_bdpm denominations; substances from CIS_COMPO_bdpm (FT preferred over SA)

ema.selection: human medicines (all statuses): Name of medicine via INN/common name

tfda.selection: 全部藥品許可證 (incl. cancelled), Chinese-medicine and device licences excluded; 中文品名+英文品名 via 主成分略述

health_canada_dpd.selection: human products, all statuses returned by the API

sfda.selection: all 460 pages of the public drugs list

rxnorm.selection: brand in brackets of SBD/BPCK concepts related to each ingredient (single-ingredient only; combinations with an antipsychotic listed separately)
